recommendations.hypothesis: A controlled increase in traffic or messaging that pre-qualifies ticket intent can increase A/B rate without materially degrading matched cost per A/B lead.
recommendations.action: Run a controlled Meta test that isolates ticket-intent framing or equivalent pre-qualification while preserving the current matched commercial baseline.
recommendations.population: Meta Lead Ads audiences and ads with traceable ad_id_norm in the matched commercial universe.
recommendations.guardrail: cost_per_ab_commercial_matched must not materially worsen versus baseline.
recommendations.expected_direction: Increase A/B share and maintain or improve cost per A/B lead.
recommendations.success_criterion: A/B rate improves with sufficient matched sample and no material deterioration in cost_per_ab_commercial_matched.
recommendations.validation_window: At least two complete comparable weeks or a documented approved period rule.
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: Stop or review if sample remains low, matched coverage degrades, or cost per A/B worsens.

recommendations.action: Review and document why 187 lead-side leads and 2.20 EUR commercial spend remain outside matched coverage.
recommendations.verifiable_result: Coverage register classifies each lead_only and spend_only ad_id_norm as expected, data latency, mapping gap, or unresolved.
recommendations.closure_criterion: All unmatched ad_id_norm values have a documented cause or an explicit UNKNOWN retained for future execution.
recommendations.risk: Without this review, quality-rich lead_only groups can be overread economically.
recommendations.dependency: Authorized data owner review of ad_id_norm mapping and spend ingestion coverage.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improves reliability of future cost-quality decisions.
recommendations.confidence: high for need, medium for remediation impact.

recommendations.hypothesis: Reducing dependency on the two highest-volume ads while testing adjacent concepts can preserve volume and improve robustness of quality signals.
recommendations.action: Create a small controlled creative/message diversification test anchored to ad_id_norm tracking, not ad_name as key.
recommendations.population: Matched ads with sufficient denominator, excluding spend_only and lead_only from cost-quality claims.
recommendations.primary_metric: matched A/B leads per ad and cost_per_ab_commercial_matched
recommendations.guardrail: Total matched lead volume should not fall materially during the test.
recommendations.expected_direction: Maintain volume while reducing concentration risk and finding additional qualified pockets.
recommendations.success_criterion: At least one non-dominant ad reaches sufficient sample with comparable or better A/B rate and acceptable cost per A/B lead.
recommendations.validation_window: Two complete comparable weeks or one approved full evaluation period.
recommendations.uncertainty: Current evidence supports concentration, not creative causality.
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: Stop or review if sample is insufficient or performance depends on partial-week artifacts.

recommendations.hypothesis: July partial quality may indicate improvement, but current evidence does not establish a durable trend.
recommendations.support: Monthly quality shows July A/B rate at 32.73%, higher than June's 29.51%, but July is partial and temporal spend evidence is unavailable.
recommendations.uncertainty: Partial month and rejected temporal spend queries.
recommendations.missing_evidence: Complete July period and authorized temporal spend-quality evidence.
recommendations.promotion_condition: Promote to measurable experiment or action only after a complete comparable period validates the change.

excluded_actions: No budget reallocation is recommended as an immediate decision because key economic comparisons are partial outside matched coverage.
No creative winner is declared because ad_name is a label and causality is not validated.
No revenue optimization recommendation is issued because revenue or sales conversion evidence is not available.
